author: _DISTRACTION_
body:
Builder Applications


General Information

The map development team has decided to open applications for the Builder rank, for a third time. This will allow the builder team to gain more members, and gives a people who previously did not meet the requirements, to apply for the rank.

Depending on what they are better at, builders are allowed to focus either on building maps, or on creating XML if they wish to do so. Of course, they are allowed to do work in both sectors.

Builders will be given access to test their XML files on the Development server, but they are not able to view or edit Avicus' private Github repositories.

In addition, Builder acts as a trial map developer rank; anybody wishing to become a Map Developer must first become a Builder. However, the Map Developer rank has higher standards than the Builder rank; it is possible for a Builder to never be offered a promotion to Map Developer.

Requirements to Apply

- Must have submitted at least two maps to the Avicus forums.
- Must have a Discord account, and be in the Avicus Discord server.
- Must not be currently banned ingame, on Teamspeak, or on the forums.

To apply, create a thread in the "Builder Applications" subforum with your answers to the following questions. (Include the questions, as well.)

Application Format

Part 1: About You

What is your age?

What is your Discord ID? (If you don’t have Discord, create an account and join the Avicus Discord server before answering this question.)

How active can you be in order to contribute to the team?

What attributes distinguish yourself from other applicants that qualify you to be a builder?

Part 2: Skills

What do you think is a necessity in order to hone your map building skills in terms of gameplay?

How comfortable are you with Avicus XML when it comes to creating it and analyzing it to fix possible errors?

As builder, would you focus on building maps, creating XML, or both?

Part 3: Past Experience

Provide the links for the threads of two maps that you have submitted to the Avicus forums.

Have you had any past experience with building maps or creating XML, other than with the two maps linked above? If so, explain.

Part 4: Self Reflection

Why do you want to be a builder?

How do you think you will help the map development team?

Applications will be open starting 8/30/2017, and will not close until further notice. There is a strict limit of 1 unanswered application per person, and there is a 29 day cooldown between posting applications.
